title: POST /routes – request
description: Create a route on a site of the caller, without checkpoints: they come with POST /routes/{id}/versions. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 201, api/route.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent.

order_mode.description: fixed: checkpoints must be scanned by position; free: any order.
